items.why: Volatility is spiking as the sell-off continues, with investors fretting about AI, tariffs, and inflation and turning to defensive positioning.
The chip rout continues as the Dow, S&P 500, and Nasdaq sink on hot inflation and new Trump tariffs, and AMD is caught in the sector-wide slide.
Nvidia leads the resumption of the AI sell-off; headlines note the return of CEO Jensen Huang failed to quell AI doubts and warn an AI wipeout could have broad consequences.
No single headline; moving with the broader tape.

market_note: S&P futures down 2.81% and Nasdaq futures down 4.35% as the chip rout continues.
summary: Stocks are selling off sharply in a tech-led slide as hot inflation, new Trump tariffs, and a continuing chip rout weigh on the market. The Nasdaq is down more than 4% with chip names leading the drop, and the VIX is spiking as investors reach for protection.
